title: Extension by an essentially constant system preserves Mittag-Leffler (Stacks 070D)
statement: Let $0\to(A_i)\to(B_i)\to(C_i)\to0$ be a short exact sequence of inverse systems of abelian groups indexed by $i\ge1$ [def-weil-inverse-system] (morphisms of inverse systems $(A_i)\to(B_i)\to(C_i)$ such that $0\to A_i\to B_i\to C_i\to0$ is exact for every $i$). If $(C_i)$ is essentially constant [def-weil-pbc-essentially-constant-system], then $(A_i)$ is ML if and only if $(B_i)$ is ML [def-weil-pbc-mittag-leffler-system].
